actualIdentityBoundaries.normalNative: Sampled actual owned testhost CoreCLR/CoreLib/testhost.exe/testhost.dll and host modules; exact module paths, hashes and versions. Managed owner/manager were not present in the early native module snapshot.
actualIdentityBoundaries.nativeOwnerFileProvenance: Exact command/TRX codeBase/full normal inventory and selected PE/PDB bytes, not a claim of native in-process observed managed owner MVID.
actualIdentityBoundaries.supplemental: Actual in-process common consumer, role owner, role public manager producer and CoreLib identities, plus four-name-bounded native module observations.
actualIdentityBoundaries.sdkStartupHook: SDK/VSTest runtime57 only; no native testhost receipt obtained. Kept distinct from the subsequent unhooked native replay at runtime62/runtime69.
actualIdentityBoundaries.runtimeHostDistinction: Both native hosts loaded hostfxr65; actual CoreCLR/CoreLib are Original62 and Default69. Host/SDK identity is not substituted for assertion-runtime identity.

selectedAttestation.boundaries: Selected PE/PDB bytes, all documents in every selected PDB, selected normal deps/config/assets, complete declared native/runtime image filename/hash inventories. Not all native dependency bytes or all native compiler inputs.
selectedAttestation.peOnlyPdbsNotSelected: Other selected PE-only dependencies/compiler references/CoreLib/native modules have no selected PDBs; no source-document claim for their unselected PDBs.
